appEditor.unavailable: An app you can’t use here

typeTips.rich_text: Text you can format. Good for summaries, notes and descriptions.
typeTips.number: Holds a number, shown plain, as a currency or as a progress bar. Good for counts, prices and progress.
typeTips.select: Choose one tag from a list. Good for sorting items into categories.
typeTips.multi_select: Choose any number of tags from a list. Good for items that belong to several categories.
typeTips.status: Shows where an item stands with tags grouped into To-do, In progress and Complete.
typeTips.date: Holds a date or a date range, with an optional time. Good for deadlines, and works with calendar and timeline views.
typeTips.person: Mention people in your workspace. Good for assigning tasks or naming who’s involved.
typeTips.files: Keeps files and images with the item, ready to open again. Good for documents and photos.
typeTips.checkbox: A yes-or-no box you tick. Handy for simple to-do tracking.
typeTips.url: Holds a web link; clicking it opens the site in a new tab.
typeTips.phone: Holds a phone number; clicking it lets your device call it.
typeTips.email: Holds an email address; clicking it opens your mail app.
typeTips.relation: Links to pages in another database. Good for tying related items together across your workspace.
typeTips.rollup: Pulls in and totals property values through a relation. Good for summing up linked data.
typeTips.formula: Calculates a value from other properties with a formula.
typeTips.button: Runs actions using the item’s properties.
typeTips.unique_id: Gives each item a number ID automatically. IDs never repeat and can’t be changed by hand.
typeTips.place: Shows a real-world location on a map.
typeTips.verification: Shows whether the page owner has verified a page, optionally until a set date.
typeTips.created_time: Filled in with when the item was created. Set automatically; can’t be edited.
typeTips.last_edited_time: Filled in with when the item was last edited. Updated automatically; can’t be edited.
typeTips.created_by: Filled in with whoever created the item. Set automatically; can’t be edited.
typeTips.last_edited_by: Filled in with whoever edited the item last. Updated automatically; can’t be edited.

dimmedTypeTips.unique_id: Only one ID property is allowed per database
